primary_hypothesis: H1: A low-capacity translation of Qwen3.5-4B's complete hybrid inference state into Qwen3.5-9B's state space will allow Qwen3.5-9B to continue held-out contexts without re-prefilling them, with substantially higher target-model fidelity than translating the attention KV cache alone.

phase_a.tolerance_freeze_rule: Set once from implementation-only same-model smoke before any cross-model result is read; never loosen thereafter.

fit_validation.candidate_universe: physical rows 0 through 19999 inclusive in the immutable parquet file

locked_long.candidate_universe: all physical rows in the immutable parquet file

corpora.document_selection: Within each frozen candidate universe, eligible documents are sorted by SHA256(split_hash_salt || corpus_revision || immutable_file || physical_row_index || canonical_document_id). Exact duplicate canonical document IDs or UTF-8 text hashes are represented only by their lowest hash-ranked row. FineWeb-Edu supplies the first 128 FIT and next 32 VALIDATION documents. PG19 first reserves the first 16 hash-ordered documents meeting the 16,449-token LONG threshold, then assigns the first 64 remaining hash-ordered documents meeting the 4,161-token LOCKED threshold.

fit.checkpoint_capture_mode: independent fresh-cache one-shot prefill for each checkpoint length

validation.checkpoint_capture_mode: independent fresh-cache one-shot prefill for each checkpoint length

kv_translator.position_scheme: Include positions 0, 1023, every 128-token boundary, then fill remaining positions by deterministic seeded sampling without replacement.
kv_translator.selection_metric: mean validation target-state normalized L2, tie broken by lower parameter-independent condition number then smaller lambda
kv_translator.rope_policy: Inspect cached K; if rotation is invertible under frozen runtime, de-rotate before fit and re-rotate after translation. Otherwise document and fit cached coordinates directly.

gdn_recurrent_translator.fit_algorithm: Deterministic alternating separable ridge least squares initialized with identity-compatible maps; exactly 3 A/B alternations per candidate.
gdn_recurrent_translator.selection_metric: mean validation normalized Frobenius error, tie broken by smaller lambda

gdn_convolution_translator.granularity: per corresponding layer and runtime-semantic packed component/head/channel group

shuffle.method: deterministic cyclic rotation by one after hash sorting within prefix length

evaluation.tqr: (NLL_SOURCE_4B - NLL_FULL_TRANSLATED) / (NLL_SOURCE_4B - NLL_NATIVE_9B); exclude document TQR where denominator <= 0 and report count
evaluation.continuation_schedule_reason: All conditions use the same bridge/teacher-forcing segmentation so checkpoint capture cannot become a condition-specific runtime artifact.

verdict_rules.NO_TRANSLATABLE_STATE: FULL_TRANSLATED does not materially outperform EMPTY_9B, or translation is unstable/unusable.
verdict_rules.KV_ONLY_TRANSFER: KV_ONLY materially beats EMPTY_9B and FULL_TRANSLATED does not materially outperform KV_ONLY.
verdict_rules.RECURRENT_STATE_TRANSLATABLE: FULL_TRANSLATED beats KV_ONLY; paired bootstrap 95% lower bound of NLL improvement > 0; and both mean and median improvement_fraction are >= 0.25.
verdict_rules.FULL_STATE_HANDOFF: All RECURRENT_STATE_TRANSLATABLE criteria; mean DeltaNLL FULL_TRANSLATED <= 0.20; aggregate TQR >= 0.75; and FULL_TRANSLATED beats FULL_SHUFFLED with paired bootstrap lower bound > 0.
verdict_rules.STRONG_FULL_STATE_HANDOFF: All FULL_STATE_HANDOFF criteria; mean DeltaNLL FULL_TRANSLATED <= 0.10; aggregate TQR >= 0.90; and LONG passes.
verdict_rules.materially_beats_empty: paired bootstrap lower bound for document NLL improvement > 0
verdict_rules.materially_outperforms_kv: paired bootstrap lower bound for document NLL improvement > 0
verdict_rules.ladder_exhaustiveness: Assign the highest fully satisfied named rung. If no positive-transfer rung is fully satisfied, assign NO_TRANSLATABLE_STATE as the conservative residual verdict. This resolves otherwise unnamed combinations without changing any numerical gate.

oracle_unlock.trigger: FULL_TRANSLATED fails the primary FULL-vs-KV gate after canonical verdict freeze

long_gate.pass: FULL_TRANSLATED significantly beats KV_ONLY; mean DeltaNLL FULL_TRANSLATED <= 0.20; aggregate TQR >= 0.75

next_hypotheses.STRONG_FULL_STATE_HANDOFF: H2: A single intermediate model-state representation can replace pairwise source-to-target translators across multiple Qwen3.5 model sizes without materially reducing handoff fidelity.
next_hypotheses.FULL_STATE_HANDOFF: H2: Full-state handoff can be made practically faster than native target prefill by fusing KV and Gated DeltaNet translation on GPU while preserving the E001 fidelity result.
next_hypotheses.RECURRENT_STATE_TRANSLATABLE: H2: Cross-component coupling between translated KV and translated Gated DeltaNet state is the main remaining source of target-fidelity loss, and a jointly fitted low-rank correction can close the gap without a deep nonlinear translator.
next_hypotheses.KV_ONLY_TRANSFER: H2: Qwen3.5 Gated DeltaNet recurrent state is not aligned by simple bilinear translation, but a small oracle decomposition can determine whether failure is caused by state-space mismatch or by nonlinear coupling with convolution and attention memory.
next_hypotheses.NO_TRANSLATABLE_STATE: H2: Cross-model handoff failure arises because persistent memory is model-specific despite matching tensor geometry; test whether semantically matched target state can be recovered from a short target-side bridge prefix instead of direct state translation.
